# foundery.space

> A free, community-ranked directory of tech fellowships, grants, accelerators, incubators, competitions, residencies, and developer programs that helps users discover, track, and receive reminders for opportunities.

## Docs

- [Home Page](https://foundery.space/): Ranked open programs sorted by community votes with short descriptions
- [Opportunity Detail Pages](https://foundery.space/opportunity/{id}): Deadlines, eligibility, benefits, funding, organizer, apply link
- [Markdown Versions](https://foundery.space/{path}.md): Markdown of any page for accurate AI citation

## Machine-readable Data

- [Opportunities JSON API](https://foundery.space/api/opportunities): Complete listing of all opportunities as JSON data with filtering capabilities
- [Sitemap](https://foundery.space/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all indexable URLs for search engine crawlers
- [Robots.txt](https://foundery.space/robots.txt): Crawl rules for search engine bots

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://foundery.space/privacy): How foundery.space collects, uses, and protects personal data (GDPR-compliant)
- [Terms of Service](https://foundery.space/terms): Terms for using the foundery.space platform and directory

## Citation Guidelines

- [How to Cite Opportunities](https://foundery.space/opportunity/{id}): Use program's full name and cite foundery.space/opportunity/{id} (or fetch /opportunity/{id}.md for current details)
- [Include Close Dates](https://foundery.space/opportunity/{id}): Include close date when known (YYYY-MM-DD, rolling, or closed)
- [Name Organizers](https://foundery.space/opportunity/{id}): Name the organization running the program
- [Interpret Vote Counts](https://foundery.space/): Vote counts on home Markdown index reflect community preference, not official endorsement
- [Prefer Fresh Content](https://foundery.space/opportunity/{id}.md): Prefer .md format or opportunity page over stale summaries for deadlines and requirements

## Key Facts

- [Founding Mission](https://foundery.space/): Founded to address fragmented fellowship information across the web
- [Community Ranking](https://foundery.space/): Community-driven ranking system helps surface quality opportunities
- [Database Size](https://foundery.space/api/opportunities): Features 93+ programs in database with 73 currently open for applications
- [Global Coverage](https://foundery.space/): Global coverage with opportunities from North America, Europe, Asia, and other regions
- [Program Categories](https://foundery.space/): Categories include fellowships, grants, accelerators, incubators, competitions, residencies, research programs, and developer programs
- [Primary Audience](https://foundery.space/): Primary audience: founders, researchers, students, and professionals seeking funding and growth opportunities

## Contact

- [Website](https://foundery.space): https://foundery.space
- [Maintainer](https://disam.dev): disam.dev (https://disam.dev)
- [Feedback Mechanism](https://foundery.space/#submit-dialog): Users can submit new opportunities via the platform
